summary: Describes the data compression algorithms of the Dacom 450 fax machine in detail and the Dacom 500 briefly. The Dacom 500 was used by the INTELPOST electronic-mail network under development by the US Postal Service and foreign administrators.

eli5.summary: Fax pictures are mostly blank space, so machines squeeze them down. This memo explains how two particular machines do the squeezing and unsqueezing.
